sentences.text: Alex Wells became CEO U.S. and joined the Group Executive Committee in September 2026, succeeding Sierra Signorelli, with Mario Greco saying Wells's appointment positions Zurich to build on recent progress.

sentences.quote: Kristof Terryn is appointed CEO of Beazley and Zurich Global Specialty, subject to regulatory approval.
sentences.text: On completing the 8.1 billion pound Beazley acquisition, Zurich named Kristof Terryn CEO of Beazley and Zurich Global Specialty, subject to regulatory approval, as Beazley CEO Adrian Cox departed; Helen Pickford became CFO and Sally Henderson chief people and sustainability officer.
Greco said integrating Beazley into Global Specialty will accelerate growth, with over $1 billion of added annual revenue targeted by 2029.
Luciano Cirina joined the ExCo in 2026 as CEO International Commercial.

citations.quote: Zurich CEO Mario Greco received total compensation of 10,39 million francs last year.
citations.title: Zurich Chief Earns Significantly Higher Pay

sentences.text: Mario Greco has led Zurich since 2016, and the group has a record of raising and meeting targets: new 2025-2027 goals were set a year early because the group was on track to exceed all targets in its 2023-2025 plan, and 2025 delivered record business operating profit of USD 8.9bn, up 14%, with core return on equity of 26.9% against a target above 23%.

Capital allocation favours disciplined underwriting and distributions: a Swiss Solvency Test ratio of 259% versus a 160% floor, USD 7.4bn of cash remittances, and over CHF 32.5bn returned to shareholders in a decade at an 18% annualised total return.

sentences.quote: Zurich CEO Mario Greco received total compensation of 10,39 million francs last year. This is shown in the annual report published on Thursday by the Swiss insurance group.
sentences.text: CEO pay was CHF 10.39m in 2025, with group executive committee pay of CHF 57.67m, disclosed in the annual report.

citations.title: Zurich Insurance Announces Financial Targets For 2025-27

sentences.text: Zurich Insurance Group AG targets core earnings per share growth above 9% per year, core return on equity above 23% and cumulative cash remittances above USD 19 billion over 2025-2027, targets it confirmed as on track at its November 2025 Investor Day.
Shareholder returns are formulaic, with dividends set at 75% of sustainable net income plus buybacks as excess capital allows, and a Swiss Solvency Test floor of 160%.

sentences.quote: For Commercial Insurance, the Group expects business operating profit to exceed $4.2 billion and middle market gross written premiums to surpass $10 billion by the end of 2027.
sentences.text: Commercial insurance is the main growth engine, with business operating profit targeted above USD 4.2 billion and middle market gross written premiums above USD 10 billion by 2027.

Diversification showed in record first-half 2026 operating profit of USD 4.8 billion, with property and casualty at USD 2.8 billion on a 92.7% combined ratio, record Life profit and the strongest Farmers half-year ever.
The agreed USD 10.9 billion Beazley acquisition would create a global specialty insurance leader.
